blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover several important behaviors, but do not test many specified requirements such as missing keys, non-object JSON, invalid event IDs, tenant/session/op/status constraints, numeric bounds, or all wrong-type cases.
advice: pinned_dependencies: The Dockerfile uses the floating python:3.13 image tag and the test script installs curl through an unpinned apt package; although pytest, the pytest plugin, and uv are version-pinned, dependency pinning is not comprehensive.
